evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a date only, with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-10-02"} returned 200 and set the date. PATCH with {"title":"none2"} left the date unchanged. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null. A later PATCH set the date again.
evidence.AC3: POST and PATCH with dueDate "2026-02-30", "14.10.2026", "abc", 123 and "2026-10-14T10:00:00" all returned HTTP 400.
evidence.AC4: With today = 2026-10-14, I created a past-due todo, a future one, one due today, one with no date, and a past-due todo marked done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the past-due not-done todo (id 1) and id 4, which I had set to 2026-10-02. It excluded the future, today, no-date and done todos.
evidence.AC5: The page snapshot at / showed each dated todo with its date, e.g. "past (2026-10-01)", "future (2026-12-01)" and "today (2026-10-14)".
evidence.AC6: The page showed the text "überfällig" only on the two overdue todos (past, 2026-10-01; none2, 2026-10-02). It was absent on the future, today and done past-due todos.
evidence.AC7: The page has a button "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only the two overdue todos, past and none2.
